title: Chapter 1365 - 30: Temporal Lifeform "Galaxy" (End Of This Volume)

Chapter 1365 - 30: Temporal Lifeform "Galaxy" (End Of This Volume)

Chapter 1365: Chapter 30: Temporal Lifeform "Galaxy" (End of This Volume)

So, can you win?

This causal inference is basically correct for life forms below the thirteen stages.

But for time life forms, it isn’t necessarily true.

Because time life forms fundamentally won’t make a move against an enemy they can’t defeat.

If they can’t win, they simply won’t fight.

Or, they’ll fight using other certain methods.

As long as they find the timeline where they can defeat a stronger opponent.

And the opponent hasn’t found this timeline to take action.

Then they’ve won.

The path to victory for time life forms.

Is not limited to offensive and defensive maneuvers.

"After becoming a time life form, the next direction of cultivation is to understand one’s own Origin Dao."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Each time life form has a different Origin Dao.

For example, Lin Yuan’s Origin Dao is the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao.

The level of the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao.

The Chaotic Taiji Dao is the chaotic path created by Lin Yuan.

The infinite dimensions do not have this Dao as guidance.

Therefore, Lin Yuan wants to understand the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao mainly by himself.

"Generally, understanding one’s own Origin Dao can essentially step into the Second Realm."

Lin Yuan thought to himself, the Origin Dao has basically reached the limit of infinite dimensions. Beyond this, is the Supreme Rule Dao.

And the Supreme Rule Dao belongs to the infinite dimensions. Time life forms understand the Supreme Rule Dao only as a reference, to perfect and fill their Origin Dao.

"Within the time cycle, the Supreme Rule Dao replicated one of my imprints for exchange. I can directly observe the operation of the solar and lunar Origin Dao."

Lin Yuan’s gaze looked beyond the Chaos Void.

The invisible Supreme Rule Dao transmitted fluctuations. As long as Lin Yuan was willing, he could observe the operation of the Taiyin and Taiyang Origin anytime.

Though the infinite dimensions lack the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao, they do have the Chaotic Origin Taiyin and solar two Daos.

The Chaotic Origin solar Dao is one of the fundamental Daos maintaining the infinite dimensions. Lin Yuan’s Chaotic Taiji Dao was understood based on this.

Originated from Taiyin and Taiyang, yet transcended Taiyin and Taiyang.

"Wait a while before watching."

Lin Yuan restrained his thoughts, not immediately watching the operation of the Chaotic solar and lunar Origin Dao.

There is no rush now, having just entered the thirteen stages, there is still significant room for growth and improvement.

After reaching the ultimate point, watching will definitely have a greater impact. After all, this opportunity to directly observe the operation of the Origin Dao is rare.

Even for the Time Lord, it is difficult to have such an opportunity.

...

Withdrawing his gaze, Lin Yuan stepped forward to arrive in front of Lord Mo Xu and the other eight time life forms who had been waiting for quite some time.

"Congratulations, Galaxy," Lord Mo Xu said, smiling.

Even though he had no doubts about Lin Yuan becoming a time life form, when it actually came to pass, he genuinely offered congratulations.

"Congratulations, Galaxy."

"Congratulations on reaching the thirteen stages."

The other seven time life forms also offered their congratulations one after another.

As time life forms from the same dimensional space, they will stand together in the same camp in the future against other time life form groups for a long time.

Sharing the same hometown is a heavy bond even among time life forms.

Especially life forms from the same great extinction cycle, their relationships are quite close.

This closeness surpasses that of kin because, at such a vast difference in the levels of life, even close family can become distant.

"Lord Mo Xu,"

Lin Yuan looked at this first time life form in the Chaos Void, also feeling grateful.

Much of his growth stages, the "Infinite Void" inheritance created by Lord Mo Xu, played a significant role.

During the hometown universe, the internal world was hundreds, thousands, even tens of thousands times more evolved than others of the same level. After leaving the hometown universe, cultivating "Infinite Void" further widened the gap with Chaos Realm twelve-stage life forms.

"Every time I see your growth speed, Galaxy, I feel I’ve lived in vain all these years."

Lord Mo Xu couldn’t help but say.

This sentiment resonated deeply with the other time life forms.

"Your inheritance, Lord Mo Xu, was also a major help to me," Lin Yuan looked at another time life form, "and that Sky Void Tripod, allowing me to feel the power of the timeline in advance."

"Hahaha, Galaxy, you are too modest."

Lord Mo Xu laughed, "Even without the ’Infinite Void’ inheritance, it wouldn’t affect you much, maybe just be a bit delayed in stepping into the thirteen stages."

If stepping into the thirteen stages could rely on the ’Infinite Void’ inheritance, how could there be only seven time life forms in the Chaos Void?

Before Lin Yuan, the ’Infinite Void’ inheritance had already existed for countless ages, but how many cultivators eventually became time life forms from this inheritance?

None.

Not even one.

This is despite Lord Mo Xu occasionally paying attention, actively reviving the ’excellent’ life forms among these inheritance cultivators.

Of course, here the resurrection is limited to those who fell prematurely, not reaching perfection in the Chaos Realm.

For such cultivators, Lord Mo Xu is willing to give them a chance to be revived and start over.

As for those who reached perfection in the Chaos Realm, trying to break through to the thirteen stages, yet got trapped in the time loop?

Lord Mo Xu basically showed no interest at all.

Even if breaking the loop forcibly with a price was possible, it would lose the opportunity to step into the thirteen stages.

And for life forms without hope of reaching the thirteen stages, Lord Mo Xu had no interest at all.

Nor would he actively pay any price to break them out of the time loop.
